summary: All four phases delivered their stated objectives. The two unplanned files (src/domain/errors.ts and src/cli/commands/runLayers.ts) and the re-touching of the three phase-01 provider adapters in phase-02 are all documented in the handoffs with clear technical justifications: adding phaseFolderPath to AgentInvocationError was the cleanest way for the CLI to render the log path without filesystem access, and runLayers.ts was the natural shared home for exit-code mapping and the CLI formatter. No unjustified scope creep was found. One attention point exists in docs/security.md: the example JSON snippet still shows a name-style mcp.allow entry that contradicts the corrected table row.

findings.message: writeAgentErrorLog implemented and wired into both failure paths (spawn error + non-zero exit) of all three provider adapters as specified.
Four unit tests present: file content shape, unknown exitCode, no-op on undefined path, no-throw on unwritable path — matches test strategy exactly.
Handoff covers all required content: exact path and signature, agent-error.log format, rate-limit exclusion, completion-call exclusion, and pointer for phase-02.

src/domain/errors.ts edited (unplanned) to add phaseFolderPath?: string | undefined to AgentInvocationError. Justified: CLI has no reliable way to reconstruct the log path at render time without this field; adapters already hold the value.

src/infra/providers/claudeCode.ts, codexCli.ts, and mistralVibe.ts (phase-01 files) re-touched to pass phaseFolderPath in error constructors. Justified: one-line additive change per site; no logic altered.
src/cli/commands/runLayers.ts used for renderAgentInvocationError (listed as optional); both run.ts and resume.ts already import from it, making it the correct location.
10 unit tests in describeCause.test.ts covering enrichment, fallback, excerpt bounding, whitespace-only excerpt, and other cause types — matches test strategy.
loadRunReviewInfo tolerates empty phaseStatuses, reconstructs finalPhase* from last plan phase, sets worktreePath to empty string and claudeSessionId/commitHash to undefined as specified.

6 integration tests present: reset→resolvable, reset→resumable (phase-01 as next), no-live-folder, happy-path unchanged, missing run-status.json still fails, empty phaseStatuses with no plan still fails — matches test strategy.
Handoff confirms happy-path is unchanged, notes resolvePhaseInfo still fails for reset runs (correct), and provides clean pointer for phase-04.

mcpAllowlistPreflight added to executePlan.ts and called after required-commands preflight; fails with SecurityPreflightError naming offending entries; skips for non-allowlist modes. docs/security.md line 50 corrected to state path contract and note name-based allowlisting is unsupported.
src/cli/commands/runLayers.ts touched (listed as optional): SecurityPreflightError mapped to exit code 11, consistent with the existing SecurityEnforcementError entry. Justified and additive.
5 unit tests present covering all required cases: all-missing, partial-missing, all-present, empty allow, non-allowlist mode skip — matches test strategy exactly.
mcpAllowlistPreflight lives in src/app/ and routes filesystem check through the FileSystem port — correct per architecture rules; no direct node:fs in app layer.

attentionPoints: docs/security.md example JSON snippet (line 34) still shows "allow": ["my-trusted-mcp"] — a name-style entry that contradicts the corrected table row at line 50 and the allowlist mode description at line 68. A reader consulting only the example may still misconfigure the field. The example should use a path like "/path/to/mcp-server.json".
pointers: Possible documentation inconsistency: docs/security.md example config at line 34 uses a name-style mcp.allow entry ("my-trusted-mcp") while the corrected prose at lines 50 and 68 requires file paths — confirm via a doc review pass.
